Name: ACType
Label: AC Wiring Type
Notes:
0x0000: Three Phase (default value)
0x0001: Single Phase
0x0002: Split Phase

Name: St
Label: Operating State
Notes:
The lower 4 bits represent the switch signal
0x0000: Power off
0x0001: Power on

Name: InvSt
Label: Inverter State
Notes:
0: Standby
1: Self-test
2: Normal
3: Alarm
4: Fault
5: Activating

Name: ConnSt
Label: Grid Connection State
Notes:
(0: off 1: on)
Bit 0: INV relay
Bit 1: Load relay 
Bit 2: Grid relay
Bit 3: Generator relay
Bit 8: Gen two-wire start relay

Name: DERMode
Label: DER Operational Characteristics
Notes:
(0: off 1: on)
Bit 0: INV relay
Bit 1: Load relay 
Bit 2: Grid relay
Bit 3: Generator relay
Bit 8: Gen two-wire start relay

Name: W
Label: Active Power
Sol-Ark Register ID: 690 Grid Side Total Power High Word, 625 Grid Side Total Power Low Word

Name: VA
Label: Apparent Power
Sol-Ark Register Desc: 704 Grid Internal CT Total Apparent Power High Word, 608 Grid Internal CT Total Apparent Power Low Word

Name: Var
Label: Reactive Power
Sol-Ark Register Desc: Grid Phase A, B, C Reactive Power

Name: WL1
Label: Watts L1
Sol-Ark Register Desc: 622 Grid Side Phase A Power Low Word, 687, Grid Side Phase A Power High Word

Name: AL1
Label: Amps L1
Sol-Ark Register Desc: Grid Internal CT Phase A Current

Name: WL2
Label: Watts L2
Sol-Ark Register Desc: 623 Grid Side Phase B Power Low Word, 688, Grid Side Phase B Power High Word

Name: AL2
Label: Amps L2
Sol-Ark Register Desc: Grid Internal CT Phase B Current

Name: WL3
Label: Watts L3
Sol-Ark Register Desc: 624 Grid Side Phase C Power Low Word, 689, Grid Side Phase C Power High Word

Name: AL3
Label: Amps L3
Sol-Ark Register Desc: Grid Internal CT Phase C Current
